consumer:asset.not179@i4562:p5.question_phrase: Is this property one that does not qualify for the section 179 deduction: a land improvement ...; property held for investment; property you purchased and lease to others, unless ...; property used by a tax-exempt organization ...; or property used by a governmental unit or a foreign person or entity
consumer:asset.not179@i4562:p5.source_phrase: i4562 p. 5, Line 6, Column (c)—Elected cost (read by asset.s179_bad)
consumer:asset.not179@i4562:p5.reason: Line 6 column (c) is the elected cost of section 179 property; the question asks whether the property is outside section 179 property as p946 p. 17 and i4562 pp. 2-3 define it, which is the sense in which the gate refuses an election on it.

consumer:asset.class@p946:p17.question_phrase: or choose A (personal property with no class life), B (qualified technological equipment), C (property used in research and experimentation), or qualified improvement property
consumer:asset.class@p946:p17.source_phrase: p946 p. 17, "Land and land improvements do not qualify as section 179 property" (read by asset.is_section179)
consumer:asset.class@p946:p17.reason: asset.is_section179 reads the class only to tell qualified improvement property (section 179 property only when elected) from other classes; the land-improvement rule of p. 17 is answered by asset.not179, not by the class.
